purpose: State the portfolio-level viewpoint without transferring scientific ownership from source repositories.
central_question: Which distinctions become visible, necessary, identifiable, measurable, recordable, reportable, constrainable, realizable, actionable, or safely forgettable when the coordinate system, receiver set, architecture regime, niche representation, state/proxy measurement, reference information, record-entry process, observation contract, future responsibility, retained mechanism set, sampling location, or report target changes?

novelty_claim.allowed: A portfolio-level viewpoint: ecological variation is treated as coordinate-, receiver-, architecture-, measurement-, record-, evidence-, representation- and contract-relative state structure, while unresolved/negative/mixed/unavailable outcomes remain part of the object.
forbidden: one universal ecological state or mechanism already validated in nature
central synthesis ownership of source data/proofs/claims
treating evidence-mode overlap as scientific dependency
treating shared substrate as shared conclusion

ecosystem_system.surface: VARIATION ⇄ STATE ⇄ RECORD ⇄ IDENTIFY ⇄ DESIGN ⇄ FIELD ⇄ UPDATE
ecosystem_system.rule: All 33 active scientific repositories are placed in one ecological system; evidence-mode overlap is shown separately and is not a claim-transfer graph.

evidence_mode_view.surface: THEORY/SIMULATION ∩ METHODS ∩ PUBLIC DATA ∩ OWN/NEW DATA
evidence_mode_view.rule: This is a variance-partitioning-style evidence composition lens, not a causal decomposition or importance score.

phd_path.surface: 原点 → 記録 → 境界 → 次観測 → 忘却 → 渡す

cross_repository_invariants: required state != identified state != reportable target
phd_in_zuizui: Responsibility for which distinctions are retained, measured, recorded, constrained, represented, left unresolved, safely forgotten, made actionable, returned to field, and passed forward as revisable provenance.
